env.description: Environment the HeyForm container runs with

APP_HOMEPAGE_URL.description: Public address HeyForm is reached at, e.g. https://forms.example.com. The login cookie is scoped to this hostname, so a value that does not match the browser's address gives working pods and a login that never sticks

SESSION_KEY.description: Signs session cookies. The shipped default is a PUBLIC placeholder - generate your own with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Changing it later signs every user out

FORM_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts stored form data. The shipped default is a PUBLIC placeholder - generate your own with `openssl rand -hex 32` before collecting real submissions. Changing it later makes existing encrypted data unreadable

image.description: HeyForm container image, e.g. heyform/community-edition:v3.0.3. Raising the tag upgrades HeyForm on the next rollout

nginx.description: nginx Ingress for HeyForm. Created only when host is set

host.description: Hostname to serve HeyForm on, e.g. forms.example.com. Leave empty and no Ingress is created. Set service.env.APP_HOMEPAGE_URL to match

tlsHost.description: Hostname to put in the TLS certificate. Defaults to the host above

tlsSecretName.description: Name of an existing Kubernetes TLS secret holding the certificate for that host

minCPU.description: CPU reserved for the HeyForm pod, e.g. 250m

minMemory.description: Memory reserved for the HeyForm pod, e.g. 512Mi

maxCPU.description: CPU ceiling for the HeyForm pod, e.g. 1000m

maxMemory.description: Memory ceiling for the HeyForm pod, e.g. 1Gi

volumeMounts.description: Storage attached to the HeyForm container

pvc.description: Disks mounted into HeyForm. The default entry gives the upload directory a 10Gi volume. Set "storage" to change the size, at install time only - a live volume cannot be resized

mongodb.description: Bundled MongoDB holding forms, submissions, users and workspaces

diskSize.description: Disk for the bundled MongoDB, e.g. 10Gi. Fixed at install time - a live volume cannot be resized afterwards

redis.description: Bundled Redis used for sessions and background job queues

diskSize.description: Disk for the bundled Redis, e.g. 10Gi. Fixed at install time - a live volume cannot be resized afterwards
